definitions.gloss: to fulfill one's responsibility; to carry out one's duty
definitions.explanation: To properly discharge an obligation or duty that one has been entrusted with or is expected to carry out.

examples.japanese: {自分|じぶん}の{責任|せきにん}を{果|は}たす。
リーダーとしての{責任|せきにん}を{果|は}たしたい。
examples.english: I want to fulfill my responsibility as a leader.

examples.japanese: {企業|きぎょう}は{社会的|しゃかいてき}{責任|せきにん}を{果|は}たすべきだ。
examples.english: Companies should fulfill their social responsibility.

notes:
A common set phrase combining {責任|せきにん} (responsibility) with {果|は}たす (to fulfill, to carry out). The verb {果|は}たす is the standard collocate for {責任|せきにん} when expressing fulfillment of duty. This phrase reflects the strong emphasis on duty and accountability in Japanese society.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {責任|せきにん}を{果|は}たす: to fulfill a responsibility
- {役割|やくわり}を{果|は}たす: to fulfill a role
- {義務|ぎむ}を{果|は}たす: to fulfill an obligation
- {約束|やくそく}を{果|は}たす: to keep a promise

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {責任|せきにん}を{取|と}る: to take responsibility — focuses on accepting blame or consequences, especially for a failure
- {責任|せきにん}を{負|お}う: to bear responsibility — emphasizes carrying the weight of a duty or burden
- {責任|せきにん}を{持|も}つ: to have responsibility — simply states possession of a duty
